notes: Torsion-balance ISL test (Adelberger et al.) constraining multiple couplings: vector B-L Yukawa (Fig.1), scalar phi-gamma-gamma (gphigg<1.6e-17 GeV^-1 for m<20 meV, Eq.14), chameleon, and gamma5 pseudoscalar-neutron couplings (Fig.5). Constraint weakens (curve rises) for m above ~0.2 meV in Fig.5. Coupling type is ambiguous (paper also strongly features VectorBL B-L in Fig.1); chose AxionNeutron because Fig.5 is the dedicated coupling-vs-mass plot. Not a DM haloscope, so no local density.
